'''2019 EGP Camden Yanaga LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Camden Yanaga]] at [[2019 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Camden Yanaga]]
* '''Event:''' [[2019 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Senate Yanaga LS 2019 EGP.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-endor-grand-prix/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127124159/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-endor-grand-prix/ Internet Archive]
